senses.gloss: to cut, v. קְסָסָה.—[Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ top הקוֹסֵס את החטים Ar., ed. הכוסס, v. כָּסַס.]
(of wine) to bite, have a pungent taste, be sourish.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:7:6">Y. Pes. II, end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>היה לו יין קוֹסֵס וכ׳</he> had a sourish wine, and he put barley into it that it might become sour (vinegar).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 6:6">Tosef. B. Bath. VI, 6</cite> if one sells a cellar full of wine, <he>מקבל … קוֹסְסוֹת למאה</he> he (the purchaser) must accept ten casks of pungent wine for every hundred.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:2">Maas. Sh. IV, 2</cite> <he>היין שקסס</he> Ms. M. (Y. ed. <he>שקִיסֵּס</he>; ed. <he>שקרם</he>, Var. <he>שהִקְסִיס</he>) wine that has turned sourish; a. fr.
